predict.name: Predict Spaghetti
predict.description: Runs the Obico ML model whether the given image has spaghetti

generate_dashboard.name: Generate printer dashboard
generate_dashboard.description: Returns the printer dashboard with the entities of your printer filled in, ready to paste into a dashboard's raw configuration editor.

init.title: Spaghetti detection
init.description: Let the integration do the detection itself, without the blueprint. While the printer is printing, a picture of the camera is sent to the Obico ML server every few seconds. A failure is reported as the event `bambu_lab_p1_spaghetti_detection_failure_detected`, which an automation can use to send a notification. Turn off the automation made from the blueprint before you turn this on, or both will run.

data.auto_turn_on_light: Turn on the chamber light automatically

data_description.obico_auth_token: The secret you set in the add-on or with ML_API_TOKEN. The old default value is not accepted.
data_description.home_assistant_host: Optional. The address the ML server uses to fetch the picture, for example http://192.168.1.50:8123. Leave it empty to use the internal address of Home Assistant.
data_description.camera: The camera of the printer, or one that sees the print.
data_description.camera_2: Optional. Both cameras are analysed and the highest score counts. If one fails, the other is still used.
data_description.print_status_sensor: The Print status sensor of the printer. The detection runs while it is running.
data_description.stage_sensor: The Current stage sensor of the printer. A new print starts when it becomes printing.
data_description.chamber_light: Optional. The light is turned on before each picture if it is off.
data_description.detection_frequency: Two cameras means twice as many pictures for the ML server, so consider a longer time.

error.required: This must be filled in to run the detection.
error.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Obico ML server. Check the address and that the add-on or container is running.
error.invalid_auth: The ML server rejected the secret. It must be the same as in the add-on.
error.no_secret: The ML server has no secret of its own and refuses all requests. Set one in the add-on or with ML_API_TOKEN.
